Spatial components are the storage elements for spatial storage cells. Instead of items or fluids, they store entire 3D volumes of blocks.

Three tiers: the 2 cubed component stores a 2x2x2 area (8 blocks), the 16 cubed stores a 16x16x16 area (4096 blocks), and the 128 cubed stores a 128x128x128 area. That last one is massive and very late-game.

Components are crafted with Fluix Pearls, Glowstone Dust, and Engineering Processors. The 16 cubed needs a 2 cubed component in its recipe, and the 128 cubed needs a 16 cubed.

Spatial storage preserves everything: blocks, tile entities, inventories, and NBT data. You can literally pick up a room and move it somewhere else.

§ePS:§f You will need a Spatial IO Port to actually use spatial cells.
